# 12. Troubleshooting

## Common issues
- AWS permissions not configured
- S3 bucket naming conflict
- Glue crawler cannot access curated data
- Athena query returns no results
- Lake Formation permission errors

## Basic checks
- Validate AWS CLI profile
- Check Terraform validate output
- Check CloudWatch logs
- Confirm Glue crawler run status
- Verify S3 prefixes and object layout
